generators.model: Blender (bpy Python module) — the PS-244 procedural scene with per-style materials (art-pipeline/ps244-blender/room_styles.py)
generators.version: bpy 5.2.2 LTS (PyPI wheel), Cycles CPU + OpenImageDenoise

generators.commercialUse: Allowed; no third-party asset, reference pack, logo, trademark, or character is used
generators.hash: Per-file SHA-256 is recorded in art-pipeline/ps250-rooms/outputs.json
generators.notes: Same geometry, camera and lights as the PS-244 room; each style swaps materials, floor, outline, daylight ambient and backdrop. Q style at 1536 x 1024 (96 samples), pixel at 384 x 256 with the PS-250D settings, by day and by night.

processors.purpose: Backdrop composite and WebP for the room; props trimmed like PS-244 and cut to the default style's trim box of the same lighting, so all styles share placements
The PS-250D pixel processing with the style's backdrop and, for light rooms, a softer shadow
